data.name: Plunderwake
data.detailed_description:
Plunderwake is a first-person PvPvE pirate extraction adventure. Sail a cursed sea, plunder the islands the Mist lays bare, hunt powerful gear, and haul your fortune home before the fog closes in. Brave the currents solo or with a crew of up to four.

The Legend of the Wake

The world has drowned beneath a cursed fog known as The Mist: a living curse that devours every shore it touches and twists all it leaves behind. But at times the fog parts, baring islands ripe for the taking. Only the boldest captains dare sail into the heart of it, where cursed treasure and terrible danger wait in equal measure. This is a time of daring voyages and high-stakes plunder, known as a

Features

Grounded Pirate Combat — Wield cutlasses and black-powder guns in weighty close-quarters duels, or man the cannons and board enemy ships in naval clashes.

Sail Out, Plunder, Make It Home — Venture from the safe shallows into the deadly deep, where the richest treasure and the fiercest fights live. Then comes the real gamble: haul your loot back to safe water before the Mist takes it. The deeper and heavier you sailed, the more dangerous the journey home.

Plunder Rival Crews and Their Ship — Outwit and outgun other captains. Sink or board an enemy vessel, and if you take down its crew, claim the key to their cargo hold and sail off with everything they earned.

A Living Sea — One handcrafted world you'll learn like the back of your hand, never the same voyage twice. Roaming bosses, shifting dangers, and the choice of how far to push keep every Plunderwake fresh — and the farther out you dare, the greater the reward.

Loot, Gear & Rarity — Gather weapons, armor, gadgets, and consumables of every rarity. Slot weapon mods, mix melee and ranged, and chase exotic treasure to grow your legend.

Upgrade Ship & Hideout — Strengthen your vessel's speed, cannons, and hull, and return between voyages to a customizable hideout to show off your haul and rally your crew.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10+
  • Processor: Intel i5/Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1050/AMD RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10+
  • Processor: Intel i7/Ryzen 7
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 3050/AMD Radeon RX 6500 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
